name: GDLM Probe
description: Logs the player's state every physics tick and every press to a file, and plays GDLM routes back on exact ticks when GDLevelMaker asks (a play.json command file). For GDLevelMaker's sim checks.

enabled.name: Log attempts
enabled.description: Write one JSON-lines file per attempt to the mod's save folder.

only-gdlm.name: Only GDLM levels
only-gdlm.description: Log only levels whose name starts with GDLM.
